# Codex (OpenAI)

OpenAI uses Codex as a name in more than one sense, so each sense is its own link:

- **The agent:** "the Codex agent", an [agent][industry.agent] ([App Server][o4]).
- **The harness:** the Codex [harness][openai.harness], an [agent harness][industry.agent-harness] ([Unlocking the Codex harness][o3]).
- **Part of model names:** such as GPT-5.3-Codex, a [model][industry.model] ([Workspace model availability][o2]); Codex also named a language model in 2021.

Codex also names several apps and tools. VS Code calls Codex one of its [agent harnesses][microsoft.agent-harness].
